description.fallback: [Anime-only side story] A team consisting of Yamato, Aoba, and Might Guy and three other unknown shinobi, set off with Naruto to the Land of Lightning, to confine him in an isolated location from Akatsuki in preparation for the Fourth Shinobi World War. The team travels to a harbour in the Land of Fire to travel by sea. Tsunade ordered them to take the long way so Akatsuki wouldn't attempt to capture Naruto.

name.fallback: The Young Man and the Sea

text.fallback: Go: The Young Man and the Sea

outro.fallback: Afterwards, Naruto notices a fūma shuriken on the marlin's forehead and pulls it out.
The marlin returns home shortly after and the Konoha sail on a new boat, waving goodbye to Yūsuke, while the fish swims off and disappears.
